name: USDX

notices.title: Legacy depeg risk
notices.message: USDX is trading at roughly a 45% discount to its dollar peg, sustained by legacy debt positions on Kava Mint CDPs. Pharos tracks the active provider entry separately from the historical cemetery incident.

mintAuthority.summary: USDX is minted by Kava Mint's x/cdp module: users lock crypto collateral and draw USDX up to a governance-set debt limit, with Kava (KAVA) on-chain governance and a Stability Committee controlling the global debt limit, accepted collateral, ratios, and fees.

controls.label: Kava x/cdp module (USDX mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-collateral and global USDX debt limits and collateral ratios enforced by the Kava x/cdp module.
controls.evidence: Kava docs describe the x/cdp module as managing CDPs that mint USDX against locked collateral up to governance-set per-asset and global debt limits.

controls.label: Kava on-chain governance + Stability Committee (KAVA)
controls.evidence: Kava docs state KAVA stakers govern critical CDP parameters (global debt limit, accepted collateral and per-asset limits, collateral ratios, fees, savings rate), and a Stability Committee can adjust a subset of parameters quickly without a full vote.

review.evidence: Kava Network documentation describes USDX as minted by the x/cdp module against overcollateralized positions, with KAVA on-chain governance and a Stability Committee controlling debt limits, collateral, ratios, and fees; specific live parameters and module admin not independently confirmed.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm current x/cdp parameters (global debt limit, fees) and whether new USDX issuance is still enabled given the sustained depeg.
